rationale.consistency: Uses the existing options-map/global-option pattern, slices helpers and unexported helper naming; comments are a bit wordier than surrounding code but match its voice.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles nil options, invalid order erroring with no global write, multiple order lines chaining via existingVal, and plugin init orders; RegisterDirectiveOrder now relies on Index never returning -1 (guarded, but Insert would panic if the invariant broke).
rationale.scope: Core change is focused; cloning the whole options map and deleting 'order' is justified by the shared-map concurrency requirement, but the RegisterDirectiveOrder rewrite is a small optional refactor.
rationale.readability: Clear names (directiveOrderForOptions), explicit order parameter threading, and comments explain the non-obvious ownership of the order value.
rationale.robustness: No runtime writes to the global order, per-adaptation cloned options, no locks needed; slices.Clone before DeleteFunc fixes in-place corruption of the default order.
rationale.maintainability: Order dependency is explicit in buildSubroute/sortRoutes signatures; minor duplication of directiveOrderForOptions(h.options) at three call sites and the 'order' key string appears in two places.
